formal1.host_precondition: grounded_sam must run with GS_EMPTY_CACHE=1 (post-warmup and post-inference torch.cuda.empty_cache; steady reserved ~3.7 GiB on the 8.1 GiB RTX 5060). Without it UE4 Blocks dies from VRAM pressure (2026-11-17 runs c/f/g/h/k/l). First inference after an idle period costs ~78 s (allocator re-expansion, log/citynav/pc-e2e/gs_probe.py), so planner service_timeout_s=120 / retry_backoff_s=20 in planner.yaml.
